Digital Wallet

Personal repo for Digital Wallet, a private offline-first Android app for cards, IDs, passwords, contacts, finances, and sales - built by OrionMD. Release-signed APKs, published directly by the developer.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://mdmac1983.github.io/DigitalWallet/fdroid/repo
